name: Aam papad
description: Mango pulp dried in sheets into a chewy sweet-sour slab.

ayurveda.note: Ripe mango is ushna and drying intensifies it.

unani.note: Garam-tar, as aam is in desi usage.

histamine.note: Dried and concentrated fruit, usually with added sugar and salt.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
